title: Embassy or consulate
description: One record: one diplomatic or consular office of one country (`of_country`) that serves travellers in another country (`country`): its address, phones, opening hours and official contact links, from the sending government's own list. Voyager use: emergency_card (embassy contacts per nationality and destination).

name.description: Office name as written (e.g. "British Embassy Bangkok").

of_country.description: Whose office it is (the sending country), in English.

country.description: The country whose travellers' list names this office (the destination it serves), in English. The office itself may sit in a neighbouring country; see `address`.

region.description: Region of `country` the list is for, if it is one (e.g. "Azores").

city.description: City of the office in English. Always paired with `country`.

lat.description: Latitude, only when the source states coordinates.

lng.description: Longitude, only when the source states coordinates.

phones.description: Phone numbers, each exactly as written plus E.164 when it is unambiguous.

label.description: The source's own label for the number, as written.

e164.description: E.164 form, only when the written number is already in international form (never derived from a local number).

contact_form_url.description: The official online contact or emergency contact page, when the source gives one instead of (or besides) a phone.

passport_services.description: Whether the source says the office issues passports or emergency travel documents.

notes.description: The source's own notes on the office (e.g. "honorary consul: limited consular services"), as written.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
